metrics.prediction_source: Four-class confusion matrix excludes calibration, face-missing, and unclassified outputs; counts for each are reported separately.

Ground-truth videos not included in this run: driver10.avi

evaluation_protocol.prediction_source: raw_model_behavior is direct classifier output; predicted_label is the final rule/temporal-filter decision.
evaluation_protocol.calibration_policy: Calibration status is copied from the prediction record's raw_behavior field and those frames are excluded.
evaluation_protocol.unlabelled_policy: Decoded frames outside all ground-truth intervals are retained in predictions.csv and excluded from classification metrics.
evaluation_protocol.face_detection_policy: Face-missing outputs are excluded from class metrics and reported separately; they are never coerced to NORMAL.
evaluation_protocol.face_expected_assumption: Frames inside behavior-labeled intervals are treated as frames where a driver face is expected; the annotations do not provide independent face-visibility labels.

distraction_decision_metrics.metric_unit: labelled frames; not event-level alert matching

metrics.prediction_source: predicted_label is the live smoothed gaze direction; raw_gaze_label is the same calibrated classifier before voting/debounce.

gaze.interpretation: Directional metrics use FORWARD/RIGHT/LEFT/UP/DOWN only. UNKNOWN ground-truth intervals and invalid predictions are excluded and counted separately.

warnings: The annotated driver1.mp4 is absent and no event manifest or independent split metadata is available.
fatigue.interpretation: No fatigue score is reported until valid labeled clips or an independent event manifest and test-split metadata are available.

warnings: No bounding-box annotation file was supplied; evaluation is pending complete frame/object annotations.
yolo.interpretation: No object-detection score is reported until every decoded video frame has valid ground-truth boxes or an explicit empty-frame row.

interpretation: Module metrics use different evaluation units and are intentionally not combined into a single accuracy or score.

rules.decision_rule: Direct classifier output is overridden in priority order by fatigue, sustained head distraction, yawn, talking, then ML yawning/talking confidence; final labels pass through a temporal filter.

final_decision_performance.prediction_source: Four-class confusion matrix excludes calibration, face-missing, and unclassified outputs; counts for each are reported separately.

rules.measurements: Raw classifier and final post-rule/post-temporal classifications are reported when behavior annotations and runtime dependencies exist.

rules.decision_rule: Calibrated boundaries create raw direction labels; a 5-frame history requires 4 votes to change the smoothed direction; integrated distraction requires 0.6 seconds away from FORWARD.

distraction_decision_metrics.metric_unit: labelled frames; not event-level alert matching

final_decision_performance.prediction_source: predicted_label is the live smoothed gaze direction; raw_gaze_label is the same calibrated classifier before voting/debounce.

rules.measurements: Raw direction versus smoothed direction is reported. The gaze direction score is distinct from sustained-distraction alert performance.

rules.decision_rule: Eye closure is debounced before the continuous-closure timer; the alert clears after eyes reopen continuously for 0.35 seconds.

raw_model_performance.status: not_exposed: fatigue is a threshold-based eye-state decision

rules.measurements: Frame-level alert evaluation is reported only for labeled clips; event precision/recall/delay requires a separate event manifest.

rules.decision_rule: YOLO detections use class-specific confidence filtering; only phone use alerts add phone tracking, confirmed-driver proximity, and persistence.

existing_thresholds.non_phone_object_alert: immediate when class-filtered detection is present

rules.measurements: Raw box and confidence-filtered detector metrics are available only with complete box labels. Final phone-use alert evaluation also needs independent driver identity and face-location labels.

threshold_audit.warning: Threshold values document the current integrated runtime defaults; they are not optimized or applied by evaluation.
